run.question:
Alertmanager alert PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus since 2026-11-16T07:09:43Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The alert is the kube-prometheus-stack rule PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers, loaded into the cluster's Prometheus via rule file prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-ac4fa589-688e-4d06-9c48-89982b78688c.yaml with expr max_over_time(prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) < 1 and for: 10m. The cluster contains no Alertmanager component at all: no Alertmanager pod, Deployment, StatefulSet, Service, Endpoints, PVC, PDB or ServiceAccount exists in any namespace, and the Prometheus namespace contains only the Prometheus/operator/KSM/node-exporter Services (9090/8080/9100, no 9093). With no Alertmanager object to discover, Prometheus's discovered-Alertmanager count stays below 1 and the rule's condition is satisfied, which is exactly the state this rule reports. The alert refers to the live Prometheus pod prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 in namespace prometheus (Services prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus and prometheus-operated resolve to 100.96.5.74, the instance IP in the alert labels). That pod is Running and Ready with 0 restarts, but was (re)created at 2026-11-16T07:09:11Z while its StatefulSet is unchanged at generation 1 from 2026-11-15T07:55:43Z; the alert instance's start at 07:09:43Z is 31s after the containers started, so the recreation likely reset the alert state through fresh rule evaluation, while the zero-Alertmanager condition itself is structural and predates it. The value of prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered itself, the Prometheus alerting configuration (an unreadable Secret), the Alertmanager custom resources and all pod logs could not be read, and the reason for the 07:09:11Z pod recreation is unknown; these are recorded as gaps. No otel-demo application service was assessed for impact, and none is claimed: this alert concerns the Prometheus-to-Alertmanager notification path.

claims.text: The PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers rule is loaded into this Prometheus: the rulefiles ConfigMap prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-rulefiles-0 in namespace prometheus contains key prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-ac4fa589-688e-4d06-9c48-89982b78688c.yaml, whose group 'prometheus' defines alert PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers with expr max_over_time(prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) < 1, for: 10m, severity warning.

No Alertmanager pod exists anywhere: the cluster-wide pod listing returns 66 pods, among them prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0, prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator-57d68989cc-hkbnh, prometheus-kube-state-metrics-7c5fb9d798-tqssx and the node-exporter pods, and none is named or shaped as an Alertmanager.

No Alertmanager workload controller exists: the cluster-wide StatefulSet listing shows only clickhouse, jaeger-traces-recorder, prometheus-alert-recorder, topology-monitor, opensearch-cluster-master and prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus; a name/image match for 'alert' among StatefulSets returns only the unrelated data-recorders/prometheus-alert-recorder, and the same match among Deployments returns an empty list.

No Alertmanager Service, Endpoints, PVC, PodDisruptionBudget or ServiceAccount exists: name-based selection for 'alertmanager' over all 52 Services, 52 Endpoints, 10 PVCs, 9 PDBs and 72 ServiceAccounts returns empty arrays for every kind.

The namespace prometheus holds exactly five Services, none of them an Alertmanager: prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator (443), prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus (9090,8080), prometheus-kube-state-metrics (8080), prometheus-operated (9090, headless) and prometheus-prometheus-node-exporter (9100); in the whole cluster the only Service exposing port 9093 is otel-demo/kafka.

The Alertmanager API is installed but unused: the CRD alertmanagers.monitoring.coreos.com (group monitoring.coreos.com, kind Alertmanager) exists alongside the other prometheus-operator CRDs, while none of the operator-managed Alertmanager downstream objects (StatefulSet, Service, Endpoints, ServiceAccount, PDB, PVC) exist.

The alert's target Prometheus is the running pod prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 in namespace prometheus: it is Running and Ready (both containers prometheus and config-reloader ready, restartCount 0), owned by StatefulSet prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus, with pod creation 2026-11-16T07:09:11Z, container start 2026-11-16T07:09:12Z and Ready transition 2026-11-16T07:09:27Z; Services prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus and prometheus-operated resolve to 100.96.5.74, matching the alert's instance label 100.96.5.74:9090.

The Prometheus StatefulSet prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus (namespace prometheus, replicas 1) was created 2026-11-15T07:55:43Z and is still at metadata.generation 1, i.e. its spec was never updated; its pod nevertheless has a creation time of 2026-11-16T07:09:11Z, about 23 hours later, so the pod was recreated without a StatefulSet spec change.

The retained events in the authorized window start only at 2026-11-16T07:17:03Z (92 events, all in data-recorders, default, otel-demo) and none involves prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 or any alertmanager-named object; earlier events, including anything about the 07:09:11Z pod recreation, are not present in the queried data.

The Prometheus and its operator are not crashed: in the cluster-wide pod listing prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 has restart counts 0,0 and the operator pod prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator-57d68989cc-hkbnh has restart count 0, both created 2026-11-15T07:55:42/43Z apart from the Prometheus pod recreation.

The rule mechanics themselves are intact and this is not a missing or renamed alert rule: the exact rule text with the prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus / namespace=prometheus selector is present in the Prometheus rulefiles ConfigMap, and the Prometheus rule API (CRD prometheusrules.monitoring.coreos.com) is installed.

The zero-discovered-Alertmanager condition is caused by the Alertmanager component itself being absent (not deployed, or deployed with zero replicas), so the Prometheus operator generated no Alertmanager StatefulSet, Service/Endpoints, ServiceAccount, PDB or PVC for Prometheus to discover; this is the condition the rule's '< 1' expression reports.

The alert instance's start at 2026-11-16T07:09:43Z, 31s after the recreated Prometheus containers started (07:09:12Z) and 16s after Ready (07:09:27Z), most likely reflects the first rule evaluations of the new Prometheus process re-creating the alert state; the restart can explain when the alert instance began, but not why Alertmanager discovery is empty.

Rejected: the 2026-11-16T07:09:11Z Prometheus pod recreation removed a previously working Alertmanager connection. Discovery of Alertmanagers comes from configuration and the Kubernetes API, and no Alertmanager Service/Endpoints/pod/StatefulSet exists anywhere in the cluster, so a restart cannot be what removed the target; the StatefulSet spec was also never changed (generation 1).

Rejected: a Prometheus/operator crash or restart loop is the cause. The Prometheus pod and the kube-prometheus-stack operator pod are Running with restart counts 0 apart from the single pod recreation, so there is no crash-loop or repeated restart evidence, and the missing connection is explained by the absent Alertmanager objects rather than by process failure.

gaps: The Prometheus alerting configuration is stored in a Secret (volume 'config' on StatefulSet prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus, name redacted) which cannot be read, so whether spec.alerting.alertmanagers references any Alertmanager and which target name it uses is unverified, and an external/off-cluster Alertmanager target cannot be excluded.

The value of prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered is not observable: the authorized Prometheus data source returns only job label values kube-state-metrics, kubelet and otel-collector, and metric discovery for job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus" returns no series, so the gauge value and the exact alert state (pending vs firing) could not be read directly.

Alertmanager custom resources (kind Alertmanager) cannot be listed with the authorized Kubernetes resource kinds, so whether an Alertmanager CR exists (for example with replicas 0) is unknown; only the absence of all of its downstream operator-managed objects could be observed.

Pod logs are unavailable in this environment: fetch_pod_logs returned 0 lines and 0 bytes for all containers of prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 (current and previous instances unavailable) and likewise 0 lines for a control pod (prometheus-kube-state-metrics-7c5fb9d798-tqssx), so Prometheus's startup/config-reload messages, its alerting section and the operator's reconciliation logs could not be read.

Kubernetes event data in namespace prometheus is not retained for the incident period: the oldest event in the window is 2026-11-16T07:17:03Z and there are no prometheus-namespace events, so the reason for the 2026-11-16T07:09:11Z pod recreation (manual deletion, eviction, other) and whether it coincided with an Alertmanager deletion cannot be determined.

Whether the alert was already active before 2026-11-16T07:09:43Z cannot be determined, because Prometheus does not persist active alert state across restarts and the alert-recorder storage and logs are not readable through the authorized tools.

kube-state-metrics object metrics (such as kube_pod_info, kube_service_info, kube_statefulset_*) are not present in the authorized Prometheus (only four recording-rule series carry job="kube-state-metrics"), and the kube-state-metrics scrape job reports no active targets, so historical object state inside the window could not be reconstructed from metrics.
The change-history integration is not available in this Run, so who or what changed the cluster around 06:59-07:09Z (including the Prometheus pod recreation) could not be identified.

No otel-demo application service was examined for errors or latency in this investigation because the alert concerns the Prometheus-to-Alertmanager notification path; no application or downstream customer impact is claimed or verified.
next_steps: Inspect the Prometheus custom resource prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus in namespace prometheus (spec.alerting.alertmanagers) and list the Alertmanager custom resources in that namespace to confirm whether an Alertmanager is configured at all and whether its replica count is zero.

If alert notifications are intended, deploy/enable the Alertmanager component for this kube-prometheus-stack release (kube-prometheus-stack alertmanager.enabled=true or an Alertmanager CR named prometheus-kube-prometheus-alertmanager with replicas >= 1) so that the alertmanager-operated Service receives endpoints that Prometheus can discover.

Query the Prometheus HTTP API on 100.96.5.74:9090 directly (/api/v1/alertmanagers and /api/v1/alerts) to read the discovered-Alertmanager list and confirm prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered is 0, since that metric is not present in the authorized Prometheus data source.

Use cluster audit logs or the change-history integration to determine what deleted or recreated the prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 pod at 2026-11-16T07:09:11Z and whether an Alertmanager object was removed around the same time.

Confirm with the platform owner whether Alertmanager has ever been enabled for this release; the complete absence of operator-generated Alertmanager artifacts (Service, Endpoints, ServiceAccount, PDB, PVC) is consistent with it never having been deployed.

content:
groups:
- name: prometheus
  rules:
  - alert: PrometheusBadConfig
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has failed to
        reload its configuration.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusbadconfig
      summary: Failed Prometheus configuration reload.
    expr: |-
      # Without max_over_time, failed scrapes could create false negatives, see
      # https://www.robustperception.io/alerting-on-gauges-in-prometheus-2-0 for details.
      max_over_time(prometheus_config_last_reload_successful{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) == 0
    for: 10m
    labels:
      severity: critical
  - alert: PrometheusSDRefreshFailure
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has failed to
        refresh SD with mechanism {{$labels.mechanism}}.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheussdrefreshfailure
      summary: Failed Prometheus SD refresh.
    expr: increase(prometheus_sd_refresh_failures_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[10m])
      > 0
    for: 20m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusKubernetesListWatchFailures
    annotations:
      description: Kubernetes service discovery of Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}}
        is experiencing {{ printf "%.0f" $value }} failures with LIST/WATCH requests
        to the Kubernetes API in the last 5 minutes.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheuskuberneteslistwatchfailures
      summary: Requests in Kubernetes SD are failing.
    expr: increase(prometheus_sd_kubernetes_failures_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusNotificationQueueRunningFull
    annotations:
      description: Alert notification queue of Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}}
        is running full.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusnotificationqueuerunningfull
      summary: Prometheus alert notification queue predicted to run full in less than
        30m.
    expr: |-
      # Without min_over_time, failed scrapes could create false negatives, see
      # https://www.robustperception.io/alerting-on-gauges-in-prometheus-2-0 for details.
      (
        predict_linear(prometheus_notifications_queue_length{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m], 60 * 30)
      >
        min_over_time(prometheus_notifications_queue_capacity{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      )
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusErrorSendingAlertsToSomeAlertmanagers
    annotations:
      description: '{{ printf "%.1f" $value }}% of alerts sent by Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}}
        to Alertmanager {{$labels.alertmanager}} were affected by errors.'
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheuserrorsendingalertstosomealertmanagers
      summary: More than 1% of alerts sent by Prometheus to a specific Alertmanager
        were affected by errors.
    expr: |-
      (
        rate(prometheus_notifications_errors_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      /
        rate(prometheus_notifications_sent_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      )
      * 100
      > 1
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} is not connected
        to any Alertmanagers.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusnotconnectedtoalertmanagers
      summary: Prometheus is not connected to any Alertmanagers.
    expr: |-
      # Without max_over_time, failed scrapes could create false negatives, see
      # https://www.robustperception.io/alerting-on-gauges-in-prometheus-2-0 for details.
      max_over_time(prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) < 1
    for: 10m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusTSDBReloadsFailing
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has detected {{$value
        | humanize}} reload failures over the last 3h.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheustsdbreloadsfailing
      summary: Prometheus has issues reloading blocks from disk.
    expr: increase(prometheus_tsdb_reloads_failures_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[3h])
      > 0
    for: 4h
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusTSDBCompactionsFailing
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has detected {{$value
        | humanize}} compaction failures over the last 3h.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheustsdbcompactionsfailing
      summary: Prometheus has issues compacting blocks.
    expr: increase(prometheus_tsdb_compactions_failed_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[3h])
      > 0
    for: 4h
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusNotIngestingSamples
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} is not ingesting
        samples.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusnotingestingsamples
      summary: Prometheus is not ingesting samples.
    expr: |-
      (
        sum without(type) (rate(prometheus_tsdb_head_samples_appended_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])) <= 0
      and
        (
          sum without(scrape_job) (prometheus_target_metadata_cache_entries{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}) > 0
        or
          sum without(rule_group) (prometheus_rule_group_rules{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}) > 0
        )
      )
    for: 10m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusDuplicateTimestamps
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} is dropping {{
        printf "%.4g" $value  }} samples/s with different values but duplicated timestamp.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusduplicatetimestamps
      summary: Prometheus is dropping samples with duplicate timestamps.
    expr: rate(prometheus_target_scrapes_sample_duplicate_timestamp_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0
    for: 10m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusOutOfOrderTimestamps
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} is dropping {{
        printf "%.4g" $value  }} samples/s with timestamps arriving out of order.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusoutofordertimestamps
      summary: Prometheus drops samples with out-of-order timestamps.
    expr: rate(prometheus_target_scrapes_sample_out_of_order_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0
    for: 10m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusRemoteStorageFailures
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} failed to send
        {{ printf "%.1f" $value }}% of the samples to {{ $labels.remote_name}}:{{
        $labels.url }}
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusremotestoragefailures
      summary: Prometheus fails to send samples to remote storage.
    expr: |-
      (
        (rate(prometheus_remote_storage_failed_samples_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) or rate(prometheus_remote_storage_samples_failed_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]))
      /
        (
          (rate(prometheus_remote_storage_failed_samples_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) or rate(prometheus_remote_storage_samples_failed_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]))
        +
          (rate(prometheus_remote_storage_succeeded_samples_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) or rate(prometheus_remote_storage_samples_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]))
        )
      )
      * 100
      > 1
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: critical
  - alert: PrometheusRemoteWriteBehind
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} remote write is
        {{ printf "%.1f" $value }}s behind for {{ $labels.remote_name}}:{{ $labels.url
        }}.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusremotewritebehind
      summary: Prometheus remote write is behind.
    expr: |-
      # Without max_over_time, failed scrapes could create false negatives, see
      # https://www.robustperception.io/alerting-on-gauges-in-prometheus-2-0 for details.
      (
        max_over_time(prometheus_remote_storage_queue_highest_timestamp_seconds{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      -
        max_over_time(prometheus_remote_storage_queue_highest_sent_timestamp_seconds{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      )
      > 120
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: critical
  - alert: PrometheusRemoteWriteDesiredShards
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} remote write desired
        shards calculation wants to run {{ $value }} shards for queue {{ $labels.remote_name}}:{{
        $labels.url }}, which is more than the max of {{ printf `prometheus_remote_storage_shards_max{instance="%s",job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}`
        $labels.instance | query | first | value }}.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusremotewritedesiredshards
      summary: Prometheus remote write desired shards calculation wants to run more
        than configured max shards.
    expr: |-
      # Without max_over_time, failed scrapes could create false negatives, see
      # https://www.robustperception.io/alerting-on-gauges-in-prometheus-2-0 for details.
      (
        max_over_time(prometheus_remote_storage_shards_desired{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      >
        max_over_time(prometheus_remote_storage_shards_max{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      )
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusRuleFailures
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has failed to
        evaluate {{ printf "%.0f" $value }} rules in the last 5m.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusrulefailures
      summary: Prometheus is failing rule evaluations.
    expr: increase(prometheus_rule_evaluation_failures_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: critical
  - alert: PrometheusMissingRuleEvaluations
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has missed {{
        printf "%.0f" $value }} rule group evaluations in the last 5m.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusmissingruleevaluations
      summary: Prometheus is missing rule evaluations due to slow rule group evaluation.
    expr: increase(prometheus_rule_group_iterations_missed_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusTargetLimitHit
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has dropped {{
        printf "%.0f" $value }} targets because the number of targets exceeded the
        configured target_limit.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheustargetlimithit
      summary: Prometheus has dropped targets because some scrape configs have exceeded
        the targets limit.
    expr: increase(prometheus_target_scrape_pool_exceeded_target_limit_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusLabelLimitHit
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has dropped {{
        printf "%.0f" $value }} targets because some samples exceeded the configured
        label_limit, label_name_length_limit or label_value_length_limit.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheuslabellimithit
      summary: Prometheus has dropped targets because some scrape configs have exceeded
        the labels limit.
    expr: increase(prometheus_target_scrape_pool_exceeded_label_limits_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusScrapeBodySizeLimitHit
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has failed {{
        printf "%.0f" $value }} scrapes in the last 5m because some targets exceeded
        the configured body_size_limit.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusscrapebodysizelimithit
      summary: Prometheus has dropped some targets that exceeded body size limit.
    expr: increase(prometheus_target_scrapes_exceeded_body_size_limit_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusScrapeSampleLimitHit
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has failed {{
        printf "%.0f" $value }} scrapes in the last 5m because some targets exceeded
        the configured sample_limit.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusscrapesamplelimithit
      summary: Prometheus has failed scrapes that have exceeded the configured sample
        limit.
    expr: increase(prometheus_target_scrapes_exceeded_sample_limit_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusTargetSyncFailure
    annotations:
      description: '{{ printf "%.0f" $value }} targets in Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}}
        have failed to sync because invalid configuration was supplied.'
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheustargetsyncfailure
      summary: Prometheus has failed to sync targets.
    expr: increase(prometheus_target_sync_failed_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[30m])
      > 0
    for: 5m
    labels:
      severity: critical
  - alert: PrometheusHighQueryLoad
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} query API has
        less than 20% available capacity in its query engine for the last 15 minutes.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheushighqueryload
      summary: Prometheus is reaching its maximum capacity serving concurrent requests.
    expr: avg_over_time(prometheus_engine_queries{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      / max_over_time(prometheus_engine_queries_concurrent_max{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m])
      > 0.8
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusErrorSendingAlertsToAnyAlertmanager
    annotations:
      description: '{{ printf "%.1f" $value }}% minimum errors while sending alerts
        from Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} to any Alertmanager.'
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheuserrorsendingalertstoanyalertmanager
      summary: Prometheus encounters more than 3% errors sending alerts to any Alertmanager.
    expr: |-
      min without (alertmanager) (
        rate(prometheus_notifications_errors_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus",alertmanager!~``}[5m])
      /
        rate(prometheus_notifications_sent_total{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus",alertmanager!~``}[5m])
      )
      * 100
      > 3
    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: critical
